preconditions.expression: isinstance(matrix, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The input matrix is a list of lists.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(char, str) and len(char) == 1 and 'a' <= char <= 'z' for row in matrix for char in row)
preconditions.description: Each element in the matrix is a single lowercase alphabetical character.
The matrix dimensions n and m are between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(matrix[0]) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: All rows in the matrix have the same length.

postconditions.description: The return value is an integer.
The return value is within the range [0, 10^9 + 7).

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for path in all_paths if path == path[::-1]) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The return value is the number of palindromic paths from top-left to bottom-right modulo 10^9 + 7.
